messages:
maria (sales): Heads-up — fintech prospect (Tier 1) emailed RFP asking for Dedicated pool that can sustain ~2M tokens/min during 9:30–16:00 ET trading hours. Also wants 4x burst for 10m at open/close. Need sizing + pricing and autoscale policy recommendation. Link: https://company.atlassian.net/browse/RFP-881 (react:eyes)

devon (product): Thanks — adding to intake. Quick clarifying Qs: which model(s) do they plan to use? sequence lengths? 99p latency SLO? commit length? Also scope: do they require Private deployment or Hosted Dedicated?

maria (sales): They plan to use open model "rwkv-7b" quantized 4-bit per their sec team. Typical prompt+generation avg seq ~1k tokens, spike to 8k for market summaries. 99p latency target is 300ms. Commit: 6 months + possibility to convert to reserved after 3 months. They prefer Dedicated (isolated GPUs) in us-east.

alex (eng-runtime): rough back-of-envelope: on current runtime with INT4 kernels, 8k sequences cost roughly 12k tokens/second per A100 equivalent? wait, let me calc: 2M tokens/min = 33.3k tokens/s. With batching and KV cache, a single optimized GPU can do ~120k tokens/min (~2k tokens/s) for large sequences — so we'd need ~17 GPUs baseline. Burst to 4x implies headroom for ~68 GPUs total for 10m windows. This is rough — need perf runs on their exact model build + quant.

kevin (eng-infra): 68 GPUs for burst seems large. We should design burst as short-lived and bounded. Ops constraints: max burst window = 600s -> we can allow up to 4x for 600s if commit and billing approved. Need token-based admission control to avoid noisy neighbors. Also request: preferred autoscale policy YAML? If so we can template.

maria (sales): customer expects burst to be 10 minutes (600s) around market open. happy to sign 6-month commit. They asked about price per GPU hour and excess burst billing. Need an estimate for proposal by EOD Thurs.

devon (product): Action items: 1) sales — confirm exact peak times and sample workload traces (prompt sets + seq dist). 2) eng-runtime (alex) — run benchmark on customer's model artifacts + pinned quant. 3) eng-infra (kevin) — propose autoscale + burst cap + billing model. 4) product — prepare SLO tradeoffs for 99p latency 300ms vs cost. Can we get perf artifacts in 48h? :calendar: 

maria (sales): I'll upload artifacts to secure bucket and share link by EOD today. Customer ok to share logs under NDA.

deploy-bot: created ticket RWI-4523, labels=[dedicated-sizing, sales-intake], assignees=[devon,alex,kevin]

alex (eng-runtime): I'll queue perf runs; pls include the quantized weights and a small sample harness. If they can't share weights, we can approximate with our internal build but results will vary. (react:thumbsup)

kevin (eng-infra): For the autoscale template — proposing policy snippet:
```
scale_policy:
  metric: tokens_per_sec
  target: 35000
  max_replicas: 80
  burst:
    multiplier: 4
    duration_sec: 600
```
Send feedback.

devon (product): Good. Tentative timeline: scope + perf = 48–72h, sizing + proposal = EOD Thursday. If blockers, flag here. (react:rocket)

maria (sales): noted — pinging customer to confirm model repo link. Thanks everyone.
